Lower bitrate when the network is busy
Turns the bitrate down while the connection falls behind and back up once it recovers: softer picture, less stutter. Turn it on for a busy network; needs PC support.
Lowers bitrate and resolution while the device is hot, if “Lower bitrate when the network is busy” or Automatic quality is on. Turn it on only if the device throttles or overheats.
Nightjar picks the bitrate for the resolution, frame rate and codec, and follows them when they change. Turn it off to set the bitrate yourself.
